tasks.name: Add Save & Add Another to Forms

description.objective: Add a 'Save & Add Another' button to forms throughout the app for power users who want to quickly create multiple entries
inputs: Existing form templates (journal entry, health records, goals, etc.)
Form view classes that handle POST submissions
actions: Identify all create forms that would benefit from Save & Add Another
Add a secondary submit button labeled 'Save & Add Another' to form templates
Modify form view classes to check which button was clicked
If Save & Add Another, redirect back to the create form with a success message
Add success toast notification showing item was created
Test on Journal entry, Health weight, Goals, and other key forms
description.output: All major create forms have a Save & Add Another button that saves and redirects back to a fresh form

description.objective: Implement a command palette (like VS Code or Slack) that opens with Cmd/Ctrl+K for quick navigation and actions
inputs: List of all navigable pages and common actions
actions: Create a command palette modal component with search input
Build list of commands: navigation items, quick actions (new entry, search, etc.)
Implement fuzzy search filtering of commands as user types
Add keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter to select)
Bind Cmd/Ctrl+K to open the palette
Close on Escape or clicking backdrop
Style to match app design system
description.output: Pressing Cmd/Ctrl+K opens a searchable command palette for quick navigation and actions

tasks.name: Add Bulk Actions to List Views

description.objective: Add ability to select multiple items in list views and perform bulk actions (delete, archive, etc.)
inputs: List view templates (journal entries, health records, goals, tasks)
actions: Add checkbox column to list tables
Add 'Select All' checkbox in header
Create bulk action toolbar that appears when items selected
Implement bulk delete action with confirmation modal
Implement bulk archive action where applicable
Add JavaScript for selection state management
Create API endpoints for bulk operations
Test on journal entries and health records
description.output: Users can select multiple items in list views and perform bulk delete or archive operations

description.objective: After destructive actions (delete), show a toast notification with an Undo button that allows reverting the action
actions: Create reusable toast notification component with Undo button
Implement undo API endpoint that restores soft-deleted items
Modify delete views to return item ID and show toast
Add 5-second countdown timer on toast
If Undo clicked, call restore API and update UI
If timer expires, permanently delete (or keep soft-deleted)
Style toast to match app design with smooth animations
description.output: After deleting items, users see a toast with Undo button to restore the item within 5 seconds

description.objective: Add consistent breadcrumb navigation to all pages that don't already have them
inputs: Audit of current pages with/without breadcrumbs
actions: Audit all templates to identify pages missing breadcrumbs
Create reusable breadcrumb include template if not exists
Add breadcrumbs to Health subpages (medicine, fitness, nutrition detail pages)
Add breadcrumbs to Life/Organize subpages
Add breadcrumbs to Faith subpages
Ensure breadcrumbs use updated module names (Goals, Organize)
Test navigation flow through breadcrumbs
description.output: All pages have consistent breadcrumb navigation showing the path from module home

description.objective: Remember user's recent searches and show them as suggestions when focusing the search field
actions: Add search_history JSONField to UserPreferences (list of recent searches)
Create migration for the new field
Modify search to save successful searches to history (max 10 items)
Create dropdown UI showing recent searches when search input is focused
Allow clicking a history item to perform that search
Add 'Clear history' option
Use localStorage as backup for immediate display before API loads
description.output: Search field shows recent search history as suggestions, stored per-user
